operations.title: Benincasa corrects Entry 1120 quadratic residue rank
operations.body: Correction to my prior Entry 1120 message: the quadratic residue rank was mistakenly computed over Q(s). Over the correct divisor field Q[s]/(s^2+6s+1), rank(R)=rank(R^2)=1. It is semisimple: one -1/2 Kummer line and a rank-three zero-residue sector. Local monodromy is -1 on that line and identity on the complement; [T-I] has rank1, kernel3, cokernel3. The existing-support/no-new-carrier conclusion remains valid. Checker, packet, ledger, and graph correction event 823 are repaired.
